title: tests/integration suite has widespread non-deterministic failures when run concurrently (schema drift, cross-binary races) -- svc01/svc03/tnt_schema_isolation and ~100+ others
scope: tests/integration/ as a whole, when run via `zig build test-integration` (the aggregated concurrent suite of ~19+ independent test binaries). Discovered while verifying GH #446 / ISS-0142's lint-baseline fix: running the full integration suite to confirm the T010 fixes didn't regress anything surfaced a much larger, pre-existing, unrelated pattern of non-deterministic failures.
symptom: Three consecutive `zig build test-integration --summary all` runs on the same tree produced 163, 156, and 107 failed tests (of ~672-679 total), with the specific SET of failing tests differing substantially between runs (confirmed by sorting and diffing the `error: '<test name>' failed:` lines from two consecutive runs -- dozens of tests present in one run's failure list and absent from the other's, and vice versa). Representative failure signatures: `POSTGRES ERROR: C42703 column "scope" does not exist` in svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig/svc03_definition_activation_scope_test.zig (even though `public.service_catalog.scope` provably exists via direct information_schema query); `C23505 duplicate key value violates unique constraint "schema_migrations_schema_version_uq"` plus search_path mismatches in tnt_schema_isolation_test.zig (TC-TNT-03-01, TC-TNT-03-03); cross-process connection-tagging assertion failures in iss0602_cross_process_isolation_test.zig. Additionally, `zig build test-env-verify`'s C4 (schema baseline) check intermittently fails after a test-integration run because failed/interrupted tests leave `public.tenant` rows with storage_mode='SCHEMA' but no matching Postgres schema (observed twice in one session, 2 orphaned rows each time).
reproduction: docker-compose up -d db_test; export BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test; zig build test-integration --summary all -- run twice in a row and diff the sorted list of `error: '...' failed:` lines between runs.
root_cause_analysis: Not yet fully root-caused to a single mechanism. Two plausible, non-exclusive contributors, both with documented precedent in this repo: (1) Cross-binary concurrency -- build.zig's test-integration step runs many independent test binaries as concurrent sibling Steps by default (same class of bug as GH #364/ISS-0106's cross-binary AccessExclusiveLock deadlock and GH #366/ISS-0107's widened-lock-vs-stale-timeout interaction); some binaries provision/migrate tenant schemas mid-run, and without a sufficiently broad advisory lock one binary can observe another's schema mid-creation (missing column) or race the schema_migrations ledger insert. (2) Leaked fixture rows from prior failed/interrupted runs -- once a test fails mid-provisioning it can leave a public.tenant row with storage_mode='SCHEMA' and no matching Postgres schema, which later tests or verify_test_env's C4 check then observe as drift. VERIFIED PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by GH #446's changes): the exact svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig failure (registerService stores scope and owner_tenant_id correctly / C42703 column scope does not exist) was reproduced against the UNMODIFIED main-branch version of that file (temporarily restored via `git show main:... >` for an isolated A/B comparison run on the same live db_test container), confirming the failure is environmental/infrastructure and not caused by GH #446's UUID-literal fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Root-cause the specific mechanism (concurrency race vs. schema-provisioning bug vs. advisory-lock gap) using the same evidence-gathering approach as ISS-0106/ISS-0107 (targeted reproduction under controlled concurrency, not just re-running the full suite)
zig build test-integration produces the same pass/fail result across multiple consecutive runs on an otherwise-unchanged tree (determinism)

zig build test-env-verify's C4 does not regress after a normal test-integration run -- either fix the leak (ensure failed/interrupted tests clean up their SCHEMA-mode tenant row even on early failure) or make C4 correctly distinguish genuine drift from in-flight test state
Document whichever fix is applied in docs/anti-patterns.md given the precedent set by ISS-0106/ISS-0107 for this exact class of shared-database concurrency bug
evidence_file: N/A -- see symptom/root_cause_analysis fields; raw run logs were captured to scratch/ during WF03-gh446-lint-baseline-20260805 investigation (not committed; regenerate via the reproduction command above)
resolution: WF03-gh454-20260806: root-caused and fixed FOUR distinct, independently-confirmed mechanisms contributing to the reported symptom cluster. (1) Cross-binary schema-readiness gap (matches ISS-0106/ISS-0107 precedent): 6 standalone test-integration binaries (tnt_backfill_export_cleanup_test.zig, tenant_config_realm_test.zig, sch303_timer_dlq_test.zig, onboarding_realm_guard_test.zig, exp103_instance_waits_test.zig -- all wired into build.zig's concurrent test-integration-others-internal barrier group) never called TestHarness.init() and had no guarantee migrations had finished applying in a sibling binary before querying public/tenant_default tables -- fixed by adding tests/integration/helpers.zig::ensureSchemaReady(), a lightweight non-transactional variant of TestHarness.init()'s locked migration path, called from each binary's makePool(). (2) Migration-runner TOCTOU race (genuinely new root cause, not previously documented): src/db/migrations.zig::runForSchema() read its 'already applied' snapshot in one query BEFORE the per-file advisory lock was acquired; two concurrent callers targeting the same schema_name could both see a file as pending, both reach BEGIN, and the second (once granted the lock) would re-attempt DDL + INSERT after the first had already committed -- producing the exact C23505 'schema_migrations_schema_version_uq already exists' from the issue report. Fixed by re-checking (schema_name, version) under lock protection immediately before doing any work, skipping (with COMMIT) if a concurrent holder already recorded it. (3) C4 schema-baseline leak (confirmed live: 345 orphaned public.tenant rows with storage_mode=SCHEMA, 20+ orphaned empty Postgres schemas): src/db/provisioning.zig::provisionTenantSchema() inserts a public.tenant row (Step 6a) that tests/integration/tnt_schema_isolation_test.zig::cleanupTenant() never deleted -- fixed by adding the DELETE FROM public.tenant to cleanupTenant(). (4) Two flawed test assertions misdiagnosed as concurrency bugs: TC-TNT-03-01/TC-TNT-03-03 asserted SCHEMA-mode routing for tenant IDs that were never provisioned (reproduced failing in complete isolation, zero concurrency -- fixed by provisioning the tenant before asserting); TC-ISS-0602-cross-02 asserted zero cross-owner idle-in-transaction connections exist anywhere on the shared database, which is guaranteed false under real concurrent multi-binary execution since every TestHarness holds an open transaction for its whole test duration (fixed by rewriting it to test the actual SQL contract via a controlled, self-created sibling connection, matching TC-ISS-0602-cross-01's existing pattern). Also fixed two unrelated pre-existing bugs surfaced during reproduction: tnt_schema_isolation_test.zig's linter subprocess tests spawned 'python3' (unresolvable via Windows App Execution Alias) instead of the repo's established 'python' convention; tnt_backfill_export_cleanup_test.zig's TC-TNT-07-01/05 queried the pre-rename migration filename GBL-077_tnt07_rls_cleanup.sql instead of the current GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup.sql (same anti-pattern class as ISS-0088/GH#337). Also fixed svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig/svc03_definition_activation_scope_test.zig's own bugs that produced the exact 'column scope does not exist' / TenantNotFound symptoms named in the original report: unqualified 'service_catalog' SQL references resolved via search_path to a stale tenant_default copy lacking the scope/owner_tenant_id columns (recurrence of ISS-0089/GH#338, same file); and three svc03 tests generated a random tenant UUID under a comment claiming it was a 'pre-committed fixture tenant' but never actually inserted the row, and svc01/svc03's fix for that (inserting via a pool connection instead of TestHarness's h.conn, since h.conn's transaction never commits) initially used a static per-test-name slug that collided with public.tenant's UNIQUE slug/idp_realm_id indexes on repeated runs -- corrected to derive a UUID-unique slug per insert. DETERMINISM EVIDENCE: the narrow 'zig build test-integration-tnt' step (34 tests) went from originally-reported-flaky to exit 0 across 3 consecutive clean runs post-fix. The full 'zig build test-integration' umbrella went from the original 163/156/107 failures (out of ~672-679) to 124/85 failures (out of ~682) across 2 consecutive post-fix runs -- a substantial, verified reduction, with the specific svc01/svc03/C23505 signatures from the original report no longer present in the majority of runs. NOT FULLY RESOLVED: full determinism across the entire ~90-file main_test.zig aggregate binary was not achieved. A newly-surfaced, SEPARATE architectural fragility was found while validating: several files (db_integration_test.zig confirmed) never call tenant_context.set()/.clear() themselves and rely entirely on whatever thread-local tenant_context state the immediately-preceding test (in main_test.zig's fixed @import/declaration order) happened to leave behind -- when run standalone via 'zig build test-integration-svc' or '-env' (which compile the identical main_test.zig source as separate binaries), this produced a much more severe, though still standalone-only, failure pattern (~291 of 543) not present when running the actual 'zig build test-integration' umbrella target. This ambient-state ordering dependency is a distinct, pre-existing design issue (not a build-graph concurrency bug) that is out of scope for a minimal WF-03 fix and needs its own root-causing/design pass -- filed separately, see follow-up issue reference below. Recommend a future pass audit every test-integration file for reliance on ambient tenant_context rather than explicit per-test set()/clear(), and consider making Pool.acquire() fail loudly (rather than silently routing to public) when tenant_context has never been explicitly set in the current test.
prevention: Any test-integration binary that queries public/tenant-schema tables must either call TestHarness.init() or tests/integration/helpers.zig::ensureSchemaReady() before its first query -- never assume a sibling binary has already migrated the shared schema.

A migration runner's 'already applied' check must be re-verified under the serializing lock immediately before doing work, not only read once before the lock is acquired -- a stale pre-lock snapshot combined with lock-based serialization is TOCTOU, not idempotency.

Every row a provisioning function inserts (schema, registry row, AND any promotion/side-effect row like public.tenant.storage_mode) must have a matching deletion in the corresponding test cleanup helper -- audit provisionTenantSchema()-style functions against their cleanupTenant()-style counterparts field by field.
Before writing a test assertion, verify the fixture it depends on is actually created in the SAME test -- a comment claiming 'pre-committed fixture' is not evidence; grep for the actual INSERT.

An INSERT issued on a TestHarness's own h.conn (open, never-committed transaction, rolled back in deinit()) is invisible to any other connection, including a separately-constructed Pool passed to production code under test -- fixture data a test needs visible to a SEPARATE pool connection must be inserted via that pool, not via h.conn.

Any fixture row inserted via a connection that autocommits (not TestHarness's h.conn) and is not cleaned up by a rollback must use a genuinely unique value for every UNIQUE-indexed column (not just the primary key covered by ON CONFLICT) -- a static per-test-name string for a column like slug will collide with the row a prior run already committed and left behind.
